headline: Malaysia and France Sign Critical Minerals MoU to Build Supply Chains
summary: Malaysia signed a Memorandum of Understanding with France to develop an integrated high-value critical minerals industry aligned with Malaysia's National Mineral Policy.
why: Critical minerals like rare earths and lithium are indispensable components for battery manufacturing and clean technology products.

impacts.name: Malaysia
impacts.why: Malaysia secured bilateral French cooperation to build domestic mineral refining capacity.
